Name: Telephone Number
Description: Primary phone number. Format 0XXXXXXXXX (NCA: mobile 02x/05x or fixed 03x); regex enforced by the registration form config. Search key - never a unique identifier (numbers are shared and recycled).

Name: Alternate phone number
Description: Second phone number (spouse or other household member is common). Same format rules as Telephone Number.

Name: Emergency contact name
Description: Name of next of kin / emergency contact.

Name: Emergency contact phone
Description: Phone number of the emergency contact. Same format rules as Telephone Number.

Name: Occupation
Description: Patient occupation (free text at MVP; needed for the GHS OPD register).
